text.tspan: Hidden Hunger Index vs. GDP per capita 2013
The Hidden Hunger Index averages three deficiency prevalence estimates: stunting, anemia, and vitamin-A
deficiency. A higher index value indicates more severe nutritional deficiencies. GDP per capita is adjusted for
inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Hidden Hunger Index in pre-school children

tspan.tspan: Muthayya et al. (2013); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2013 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
